_comment: Manual Keybase identity overrides for Gno validators. HIGHEST priority — never overwritten by AtomOne auto-match or live scrape. Keys: operatorAddress (g1…) preferred | signingAddress (g1…) | moniker (mutable, last resort). Value: 16-char Keybase identity hex OR { identity, operator?, signing?, moniker? }. Lookup order: operator → signing → moniker. Helper: node scripts/keybase-lookup.mjs <username>. Example: "g1abc...": "A2E180C6914F7F87".
